title: Jaaynde Bakkaat mo meeɗaa yiyeede
intro: Won e daartol e nder Quraana ina hollita luggiɗde fenaande renndo fof ina waawi fawde heen. Oo nulaaɗo ina darii tan, ina ñaagoo leñol gonngol e nder majjere nde hay leñol gootol hade mum en meeɗaa rewde. Duuɓi jeertinaango fof, ɓerɗe ina keddii ina tiiɗi, yamiroore Alla ndee ari e mbaadi ɓurndi hulɓinaade. Mbele acfa fintin'de oo nulaaɗo Alla teddudo?
clues: Mi neldaama jeertinoowo leñol ngol majjere nde hay leñol gootol hade mum en meeɗaa waɗde.
Leñol am noddi kam fenaande, ina hulɓina mi riiwtude miin e almuɓɓe am e leydi ndii.
Hoɓɓe tedduɓe ngari e galle am e mbaadi sukaaɓe fiyooɓe, miɗo wondi e sunaare mawnde e kisal maɓɓe.
Yimɓe am ɗaɓɓiri mi yo mi rokku ɓe hoɓɓe am, mi anndaa wonde ɓeeɗoo hoɓɓe ko maleykaaji ɗi Alla neldi.
Jom suudu am e hoore mum renndaani e iimanaagal am, suɓii ko heddaade caggal e halkuɓe.
Mi hisnaama e ɓiɓɓe am rewɓe e fajiri, nde toɓo kaaƴe bonngo yani, gure amen njippii.

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Drowned nde o woni e rewde gooŋɗinɓe
Hisnaama e lowre yiite nde alaa ko bonnata
Ɓiɓɓe hisnaama so wonaa debbo mo hoolaaki
outcome.answer: Ɓiɓɓe hisnaama so wonaa debbo mo hoolaaki

arabic: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verse: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims. (51:36)
